title: dsLOGIN
description: dsLOGIN is a must-have plugin for any Minecraft server. It ensures player account safety, prevents unauthorized access, and provides a professional-grade authentication system—giving your server a secure and polished experience.
body:
dsLOGIN is a powerful and secure Minecraft authentication plugin, Its main purpose is to protect player accounts from unauthorized access and ensure that only verified users can play on your server.
⚙️ Core Features
🔑 1. Register & Login System
Players must use /register and /login commands when they join
Password-based authentication system
Passwords are securely hashed (not stored in plain text)
🛡️ 2. Advanced Security Protection
Prevents unauthorized access to player accounts
Detects and blocks brute-force login attempts
Supports auto-kick or temporary bans after multiple failed attempts
🎮 3. Movement & Interaction Lock
Until a player logs in:
Movement is disabled 🚫
Chat is blocked 🚫
Commands cannot be used 🚫
This helps protect your server from bots and spam attacks
🎨 4. Customizable Messages & GUI
Fully customizable messages via config files
Supports titles, action bars, and chat prompts
Optional GUI-based login/register system (depending on version)
🧠 5. Session Management
Players can be automatically logged in when rejoining from the same IP
Session timeout duration is configurable
🌍 6. Multi-Language Support
Supports multiple languages
Easily adaptable for global communities
⚡ 7. Lightweight & Optimized
Minimal performance impact on the server
Suitable for both small and large-scale servers
🧩 Compatibility
✔ Works with Spigot, Paper servers
✔ Compatible with most Minecraft versions (typically 1.8 → latest)
✔ Works alongside plugins like EssentialsX, LuckPerms, etc.
📌 Commands

/register <password> <password>
/login <password>
  
🔧 Use Cases
login/register system for servers
Public survival or SMP servers
Minigame servers requiring player authentication
Hosting platforms and custom server networks
🚀 Why Use dsLOGIN?
🔐 Adds strong account protection without premium authentication
🛡️ Protects your server from bots, hackers, and fake logins
⚙️ Easy to set up and highly customizable
💡 Suitable for beginners and advanced server owners alike
